newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tiong Nam plans 1-for-4 bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Tiong Nam plans 1-for-4 bonus issue.

text.p: Malaysia's Tiong Nam Transport Holdings Bhd said it was proposing a 1-for-4 bonus issue comprising up to 14.22 million new shares.

In a statement issued by its merchant bankers late on Tuesday, Tiong Nam said it was also planning an issue of 50 million ringgit worth of five-year bonds, with a maximum of 14.22 million detachable bonds.
The 3.5 percent redeeamble bank guaranteed bonds will be structured on a bought-deal basis, the transportation and warehouse services firm said.

The planned bonus issue is to better reflect the company's current scale of operations. The bond issue will be utilised to retire and refinance bank borrowings and to finance construction of warehouses, it said.
The proposals are subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.
